blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Re-verified 2026-10-19 at XPR Network head block 409399641. xmd.token (issuer xmd.treasury; supply 2,889,867.523143 XMD) exposes only eosio.token close/create/issue/open/retire/transfer, so it has no native freeze or blacklist action. Its owner permission resolves to swapscold, a 2-of-4 Antelope multisig (metalcfo, swapsledger2, swapsledger3, swapsledger4; threshold 2), so that multisig can setcode and replace the token contract, adding a holder freeze at will; xmd.treasury's owner also resolves to swapscold. Under the FreezeWatch decision procedure (docs/blacklist-tracker.md), an admin-upgradeable token implementation is a direct Possible surface, not Yes. XPR Network's Antelope Leap producer API exposes set_whitelist_blacklist (actor_blacklist), but that is a chain-level elected-producer censorship power applying to every XPR account, not an issuer-held token control, so it is recorded as a Possible-class surface rather than the Yes basis. XMD is the sole XPR Network deployment holding 100% of supply. No parent: variantOf and mintAuthority.inheritedFrom are null. Reserve exposure (96.22% XUSDC, 3.78% MPD) would independently exceed the 50% upstream test, but a direct Possible verdict governs.
